annotation.title_clean: Lov om ændring af færdselsloven (Revision af forsøgsordninger for selvkørende motorkøretøjer og selvkørende enheder og obligatorisk digital selvbetjening ved ...)
annotation.title_en: Act amending the Road Traffic Act (Revision of trial schemes for self-driving motor vehicles and self-driving units and mandatory digital self-service)
annotation.summary_en: Danish Act No. 566 of 27 May 2025 amending the Road Traffic Act, revising trial schemes for self-driving motor vehicles and self-driving units. It empowers the Transport Minister to set trial rules, derogate from traffic law, supervise trials, charge fees, designate municipal test zones, and impose no-fault fines on permit holders. Effective 1 July 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Transport Minister may set rules for self-driving vehicle trials and derogate from several Road Traffic Act chapters
Permit holders may be subject to strict-liability fines even without intent or negligence
Municipal road authorities may designate test zones for self-driving units; testing permitted alongside trials
Minister supervises trials, may require information, charge fees and revoke permits at any time
